## About this tutorial

This tutorial is part of the training material developed for the
[AIML4OS](https://github.com/AIML4OS) project (Artificial Intelligence and Machine
Learning for Official Statistics). It is inspired by
[subject 2 of the 2026 AIML4OS funathon](https://aiml4os.github.io/funathon-project2/),
which explores the same NACE 2.1 recodification problem with a more pedagogical,
question/answer-driven approach.
